name: harness
description: Shows and drives Herdr-Jev role plans inside Claude Code: the advisor is the session, and the implementer, reviewer and reader models come from herdr-jev models list.

panes.title: Terminal panes for external workers
panes.description: Opens each codex or agy delegation in a pane of the current herdr or tmux tab (at most 3 visible, the rest queue). Off runs the same workers in the background without panes. Needs delegation.

watchClaudeAgents.title: Watch pane for Claude subagents
watchClaudeAgents.description: With panes on, opens a read-only pane that follows each delegated Claude subagent.

autoDelegate.title: Automatic shared delegation
autoDelegate.description: Triages user turns and starts the shared Herdr-Jev execution plan, including external CLIs. Keeps tools observational; unknown dispatches are retained for reconciliation.

herdrJevBin.title: herdr-jev binary
herdrJevBin.description: Executable used for triage, plan and review. Resolved through PATH unless absolute.

maxWorkers.title: Max parallel workers
maxWorkers.description: Most implementer and reader tasks harness_run starts at once.

autoRun.title: Run tasks automatically
autoRun.description: harness_plan starts every ready task and each finished task starts the next ready ones.

scopeMode.title: Scope mode
scopeMode.description: off, report or enforce. enforce hides skills and agents the harness did not select for the task; report only computes the receipt.

runbook.title: Scope runbook
runbook.description: Optional ai-harness runbook id passed to skill-select --runbook.

alwaysAllowSkills.title: Always visible skills
alwaysAllowSkills.description: Comma separated skill names the scope never hides.

alwaysAllowAgents.title: Always offered agents
alwaysAllowAgents.description: Comma separated agent names the scope never hides, besides built-ins, harness:* and the project's own agents.

autoReview.title: Refresh the harness review automatically
autoReview.description: Run the herdr-jev review once when every task is done or approved and at least one is approved.

prGateAsk.title: Ask before opening a PR without a ready review
prGateAsk.description: Off by default: the PR command always runs and the model is told the review status. On: the engine asks the person to confirm when the status is known and not ready.

codex.title: Enable harness:codex
codex.description: Registers and offers the harness:codex subagent, which runs the Codex CLI in a throwaway copy of the repository and returns a patch. Off by default: Codex can read anything you can.

codexMaxMinutes.title: harness:codex max minutes
codexMaxMinutes.description: Longest a Codex run may last before it is killed.

delegation.title: Judge delegation
delegation.description: Registers the judge agent types, batch harness_delegate with harness_wait, and enforces tiers on Agent tool spawns: Sonnet implements, Opus reviews, Haiku explores, and every brief gets the skills step.

autoOpenPane.title: Open the Jev pane when a delegation starts
autoOpenPane.description: With delegation or panes on, opens the /jev pane (live activity and progress per agent) when a delegation or Agent spawn starts and the pane is closed. If the terminal is too narrow it shows a /jev hint in the band instead.

proxies.title: Proxy supervision
proxies.description: Checks the proxies in ~/.config/jev/proxies.local.yml every 30 s, restarts a live but unresponsive user unit once per 10 min, and toasts the result.

failover.title: Failover and wait
failover.description: Swaps the main turn to the next Claude tier when a step gets no answer, diagnoses quota and overload outside the hook, and waits with a countdown before offering to continue. Workers retry and fall back through their chain.

autoResume.title: Resume automatically after a wait
autoResume.description: With failover on, sends a continue prompt when the model is back. Off: the mod only tells you and asks.

maxWaitMinutes.title: Longest wait in minutes
maxWaitMinutes.description: After this the wait ends with a notice.

odd.title: Lean ODD feature documents
odd.description: Adds /harness feature, harness_task_done with verified evidence, a feature progress bar and resume on session start. Off keeps the default small path with no question, file or block.

improve.title: Self-improvement proposals
improve.description: Mines ~/.claude/failed-attempts.jsonl and route/health events for failures seen 3 times in 2 sessions and lists at most 3 proposals in the Jev pane. Nothing is applied until you approve; a rejected proposal is quarantined.

router.title: Router (conclave or harness)
router.description: conclave keeps routing in conclave and records what the harness judge would route to ~/.local/state/herdr-jev/route-shadow.jsonl (herdr-jev router compare reports the difference). harness turns the shadow off.

rules.title: Enforce shared rules
rules.description: Blocks commit attribution lines, secrets in files and docs in work repos, asks before rm -rf and risky git push, and reminds about skills once per session. Rules live in rules/jev-rules.yml plus ~/.config/jev/rules.local.yml.

autoOpenMode.title: When to open the Jev pane
autoOpenMode.description: delegated opens the pane when a delegation or an Agent tool call starts. any also opens it when any subagent is spawned or runs a tool.

reducedMotion.title: Reduced motion
reducedMotion.description: Draws the pixel crew static: no walk, blink, shake or sparkle frames and no frame timer.
